headline: Milei Highlights Export Tax Reductions and Aims for Their Eventual Removal
summary: Argentine President Javier Milei emphasized the reduction of agricultural export retentions and stated that his long-term plan is to eliminate export duties entirely.
why: Export taxes directly affect agricultural profitability, export volumes, and foreign exchange inflows in Argentina's key commodity sectors.

impacts.name: Argentine Agricultural Sector
impacts.why: Lower export retentions improve margins for agricultural producers and grain exporters.
